title.narrative: Community Centre for disability services (C2DS)

description.narrative: The main objective of the project is to design and implement a well-coordinated and integrated model aiming to support both the developmental and learning outcomes for children and youth with disabilities by involving the municipality, social services directorate, local education office, schools, and a community support system lead and promoted by youth activists in the area.
